rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a kind, tender person or a soft, careful touch.

example.english: They are always very gentle with children.
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 sai3 lou6 jat1 hoeng3 hou2 wan1 jau4

rows.note: Use this when “gentle” means polite or courteous rather than blunt or rude.

example.english: You don't have to be so gentle with me; just say it directly.
example.traditional: 你唔使咁客氣，有咩事直接講啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 haak3 hei3 jau5 me1 si6 zik6 zip3 gong2 laa1

rows.note: Use this mainly for a person or animal that is docile, obedient, and easy to manage.

example.english: This dog is gentle and doesn't need to be tied up.
example.traditional: 呢隻狗好乖，唔使綁住佢。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 gau2 hou2 gwaai1 m4 sai2 bong2 zyu6 keoi5

rows.note: Use this construction for a slope or incline that is gentle because it is not very steep.

example.english: This road is gentle, so even a stroller can manage it.
example.traditional: 呢條路唔太斜，推嬰兒車都行到。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 lou6 m4 taai3 ce4 teoi1 jing1 ji4 ce1 dou1 haang4 dou2
